paragraphs: That's when Michael, the great angel-prince, the champion of your people, will step in. It will be a time of terrible trouble, the worst the world has ever seen. But your people will be rescued from it—every single one whose name is found written in the Book. Many who have been dead and buried for a long time will wake up. Some will wake up to everlasting life, others to everlasting shame.
Those who have lived wisely and well will shine brightly, like the clear night sky full of stars. And those who helped others find the right path to life will glow like stars forever and ever.

This is a confidential report, Daniel, for your eyes and ears only. Keep it secret. Seal up the book until the end times. Before then, people will be running around frantically, trying to figure out what's going on.

As I, Daniel, was taking all this in, I saw two figures appear—one standing on this side of the river, and one on the other side. One of them asked a third man, who was dressed in linen and standing over the river, 'How long will it be until these amazing things happen?'

The man dressed in linen, who was standing over the river, raised both hands toward the sky. I heard him solemnly swear by the Eternal God that it would be for a time, two times, and half a time. When the power of the one crushing God's holy people is finally broken, then the whole story will be complete.
I heard all of this clearly enough, but I didn't understand what it meant. So I asked, 'Master, can you explain this to me?'

'Go on about your business, Daniel,' he said. 'This message is confidential, sealed up until the end, until everything is about to be wrapped up. Many people will be washed clean and made like new. But wicked people will just keep on being wicked, with no clue about what's happening. Those who live wisely and well are the ones who will understand what's going on.'
From the time the daily worship is removed from the Temple and the horrible sacrilege is set up in its place, there will be 1,290 days.
Blessed are those who patiently endure and make it through the 1,335 days.
And you, Daniel? Go about your business without worrying or stressing. Relax. When it's all over, you will stand up to receive your reward."
title: The Worst Trouble the World Has Ever Seen
